title: Trees
notes: The chapter is dense, assertive, and law-positive: tree as nation is fixed early, then carried cleanly through anatomy, fruit, forest, beast, and garden with strong scripture seams. The Isaiah 66 gardens argument and the clean/unclean close are especially sharp. House-style And-openers recur in author prose and must be stripped. Residual presenter staging appears in Look again and Read so. One unclear phrase (The symbol supplies nothing) and a subject-complement mismatch (verses are the LORD gathering) need surgical repair; the olive-trees relative clause is slightly tangled but secondary.

proposals.old: And a nation can be fruitful in form yet condemned: Israel was __“an empty vine”__ that __“bringeth forth sym:sym-fruit[fruit] unto himself”__ (Hosea 10:1) — full of works, empty of covenant purpose.
proposals.new: A nation can be fruitful in form yet condemned: Israel was __“an empty vine”__ that __“bringeth forth sym:sym-fruit[fruit] unto himself”__ (Hosea 10:1) — full of works, empty of covenant purpose.
proposals.summary: Strip banned And-opener in author prose.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids author sentences starting with And. Dropping And keeps the claim intact and assertive.

proposals.old: And the great trees shelter others: under Nebuchadnezzar’s tree __“the beasts of the field had sym:sym-shadow[shadow]… and the fowls of the heaven dwelt in the boughs”__ (Daniel 4:12) — the peoples and tribes that live within an empire’s reach.
proposals.new: The great trees shelter others: under Nebuchadnezzar’s tree __“the beasts of the field had sym:sym-shadow[shadow]… and the fowls of the heaven dwelt in the boughs”__ (Daniel 4:12) — the peoples and tribes that live within an empire’s reach.
proposals.summary: Strip banned And-opener in author prose.
proposals.rationale: Author prose must not open with And. The sentence already asserts the sheltering claim without the conjunction.

proposals.old: And beneath the tree is the _grass_ — the individual mortal, which is its own study.
proposals.new: Beneath the tree is the _grass_ — the individual mortal, which is its own study.
proposals.summary: Strip banned And-opener in author prose.
proposals.rationale: House style bans And at the start of author sentences. Removing it preserves the mountain-tree-grass hierarchy.

proposals.old: And the symbol scales down, as the sea did: the righteous _man_ is a tree in miniature — __“he shall be like a *tree planted* by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his sym:sym-fruit[fruit] in his season”__ (Psalm 1:3); the redeemed are __“trees of sym:sym-righteousness[righteousness], the *planting of the LORD*”__ (Isaiah 61:3).
proposals.new: The symbol scales down, as the sea did: the righteous _man_ is a tree in miniature — __“he shall be like a *tree planted* by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his sym:sym-fruit[fruit] in his season”__ (Psalm 1:3); the redeemed are __“trees of sym:sym-righteousness[righteousness], the *planting of the LORD*”__ (Isaiah 61:3).
proposals.summary: Strip banned And-opener in author prose.
proposals.rationale: Author sentences may not start with And. The scale-down claim stands without the conjunction.

proposals.old: And these come up not from the garden but __“from the sym:sym-sea[sea]”__ (Daniel 7:3) — the same peoples, seen now as predators rising from the restless deep.
proposals.new: These come up not from the garden but __“from the sym:sym-sea[sea]”__ (Daniel 7:3) — the same peoples, seen now as predators rising from the restless deep.
proposals.summary: Strip banned And-opener in author prose.
proposals.rationale: House style forbids And-openers in author prose. Dropping And leaves the sea-origin claim unchanged.

proposals.old: And the crucifixion psalm shows that beast at its work: __“Dogs have compassed me… they *pierced* my hands and my feet”__ (Psalm 22:16) — the psalm rings the cross with beasts, the bulls of Bashan, the roaring lion, the dogs — and it was the dog, the Gentile power of Rome, whose hands drove the nails.
proposals.new: The crucifixion psalm shows that beast at its work: __“Dogs have compassed me… they *pierced* my hands and my feet”__ (Psalm 22:16) — the psalm rings the cross with beasts, the bulls of Bashan, the roaring lion, the dogs — and it was the dog, the Gentile power of Rome, whose hands drove the nails.
proposals.summary: Strip banned And-opener in author prose.
proposals.rationale: Author prose must not begin with And. The psalm-to-Rome identification remains fully intact.

proposals.old:
Look again at the beasts that sheltered under Nebuchadnezzar's tree (Daniel 4:12) — all the animals under its branches.
For the beast is the other figure of a nation.
proposals.new: The beasts that sheltered under Nebuchadnezzar's tree (Daniel 4:12) — all the animals under its branches — are the other figure of a nation.
proposals.summary: Remove director cue and merge the redundant follow-on.
proposals.rationale: Look again is presenter staging banned by house style. Merging into one assertive sentence drops the cue and the repeated claim without loss of meaning.

proposals.old: The symbol supplies nothing — __“in the gardens, after one”__ is among the nations, following one — and it reads with the context, for the next verses are the LORD gathering __“all nations and tongues”__ and sending the escaped __“unto the nations”__ (Isaiah 66:18-19).
proposals.new: The symbol adds nothing — __“in the gardens, after one”__ is among the nations, following one — and it reads with the context, for the next verses show the LORD gathering __“all nations and tongues”__ and sending the escaped __“unto the nations”__ (Isaiah 66:18-19).
proposals.summary: Fix unclear verb and subject-complement mismatch.
proposals.rationale: Supplies nothing is opaque beside the translators’ supplied tree; adds nothing is plain. Verses are the LORD gathering is ungrammatical; show restores agreement while keeping the nations context.
